e1sygk6n1shdx.speaker: iwamoto
e1sygk6n1shdx.text: Osaka's a town of trade. And you can't trade on your own. It only works when everyone's there — people who sell, people who buy, people who carry, people who write it all down.

exgcl9ny7vuc.speaker: nekmax
exgcl9ny7vuc.text: In 1909, Iwamoto travelled to America as a member of a group of Japanese businessmen. There he saw rich people giving their fortunes for everyone in their towns — and it moved him deeply.

e19nz0um1j78d.speaker: nekmax
